title: Hiking With Your Dog Printable Guide, Dog Hiking Checklist, Dog First Aid Kit List, Dog Hike Log, Gift for Dog Lover, Trail Dog PDF
description:
Hiking with your dog is one of the best parts of having one. This 20-page guide helps you get the two of you trail-ready step by step, know the rules before you arrive, and pack the right things for both of you.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Start with your vet: age, breed and health come first
- Is my dog trail-ready? A self-check for recall, leash manners and fitness
- Build up slowly: a 4-week start plan in miles and km, and signs your dog needs a rest
- Where dogs can hike: national parks vs national forests vs state parks, leash rules and the BARK Ranger program
- Trail manners: leash, yielding, other dogs, horses and nervous people
- Water and food, heat and cold (hot ground, paws, signs of overheating and when to stop)
- Paw checks and the after-hike tick check
- Wildlife, streams and crossings
- Poop and Leave No Trace with a dog
- Fill-in pages: dog first aid kit checklist, dog pack list, your own pack list, a dog ID and emergency card, a trail plan and a 2-page dog hike log

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Not a substitute for your vet. Ask your vet before starting longer hikes. Pet rules differ by park, so check the official pets page before you go. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
